verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.body: Confirm that this address belongs to you so it can be used to reach you. The link is valid for {hours} hours.
verifyEmail.footer: You are receiving this because an account was created with this address. If it was not you, ignore this message.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password
passwordReset.body: Somebody asked to reset the password for your account. The link is valid for {minutes} minutes and can be used once.
passwordReset.footer: If you did not ask for this, ignore this message — your password stays as it is.

invite.subject: You have been invited to Knowledge
invite.body: An account has been created for you.
invite.expiry: Choose a password to sign in. The link is valid for {hours} hours.
invite.footer: If you were not expecting this, ignore this message.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: The password for your account was just changed, and every other session was signed out.
passwordChanged.notYou: If this was not you, reset your password now.
passwordChanged.footer: This is a security notice and is sent regardless of your notification settings.

notification.footer: You are receiving this because you were named directly. Change what reaches your email at {url}

alert.subject: Source needs attention: {title}
alert.body: The source of “{title}” needs your attention.
alert.paused: “{title}” was restored to an earlier revision, so its source is paused. New versions are counted, not written, until someone resumes it.
alert.gone: The source of “{title}” has answered “not found” three times in a row. The page was archived and the pages that link to it were marked outdated.
alert.failing: The last three syncs of “{title}” failed. The page still shows the last version it read.
alert.held: A new version of the source of “{title}” no longer reads the way the page expects — its extraction recipe fails, or a spec no longer parses — so it was held. The page stays on its last good version; its Source panel says why.
alert.breaking: The source of “{title}” published an API spec version with breaking changes. It is the page now. Pages that link to it were asked for a check if an operation was removed.
